summary: Operator RV page and FAQ, Google panel and imagery read: winery with 9 RV hookup sites (electric + water, seasonal water and dump), $50 a night standard, $100 holiday weekends, $25 for Harvest Hosts members; book by phone or email. Google 4.9/62. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway. Price gate: passes at exactly $50 (not over). Real numbered hookup sites sold to the public, not just a members' lot allowance. Groups written manual; note cleaned.
flags: PRICE GATE: stored $50-100 rechecked. Cheapest real night for the public is $50 ('Standard Nightly Rate | $50/night'), which is not OVER $50: passes. $100 applies only on four holiday weekends. The $25 rate needs a Harvest Hosts membership (third-party, not an operator discount) and was not used. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km; no operator member discount.

NATURE OF THE SITES (keep): not just a Harvest Hosts-style parking allowance. The winery sells '9 RV HOOK UPS ELECTRIC + WATER' to anyone at a posted $50, books them by phone or email with a cancellation policy, and assigns an 'RV slot number' at check-in; Harvest Hosts members are a separate, cheaper channel. Guest quotes on the page: 'several pull through, level sites. Water and electric at each site'. Borderline as a campground (no restrooms or showers mentioned; check-in depends on tasting-room hours), but it meets the presence and price rules.
PRESENCE: operator page with phone 815-302-8875 and posted price; Google 4.9/62.
LONG-STAY: none; checkout 'the following day' wording implies short stays only. Pass.
